name: cell line annotations
description: Static MCCA cell line annotation table.

Lineage.description: Broad tissue or cellular lineage context of the MCCA sample.

CancerType.description: MCCA disease or entity category. Despite the column name, this can include non-malignant contexts such as healthy tissue or precursor lesions when they are part of a cancer-evolution model system.

CancerTypeDetailed.description: More specific MCCA entity, subtype, or disease-stage category within CancerType.

MouseModelDetailed.description: Detailed mouse model annotation, including genotype and treatment components when present.

ComplexRearrangement.description: Indicates whether complex rearrangement is annotated for the cell line.

Chromothripsis.description: Indicates whether chromothripsis is annotated for the cell line.

SurvivalDays.description: Mouse survival time in days when available.

Gender.description: Reported sex of the mouse from which the cell line was derived.

ImmunocompetentTransplantation.description: MCCA category for immunocompetent transplantation suitability.
